question.prompt:
Point \(A\) lies outside line \(l\), \(AD\perp l\) at point \(D\), and \(AD=5\) cm. Point \(B\) lies on \(l\), and \(AB=7\) cm. What is the distance from point \(A\) to line \(l\), in cm?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_065_q2_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: The distance from a point to a line is the length of the perpendicular segment, namely \(AD=5\) cm. (\(AB\) is an oblique segment and is longer than the perpendicular segment.)
solutions.title: Use the definition of distance
